"""Pilot recipe only: prove a suspended, settled headset grip with checked motion."""
import numpy as np
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T, angle_between_R
from dojo.skills.kinematics import TABLE_Z
from dojo.skills.skills import SkillResult, CLOSED
from dojo.skills.executor import ArmPlan, BudgetExceeded, EpisodeEnded

def loaded_hold(sk, pp, result):
    if not result.ok or result.status != 'loose' or sk.world.obj(pp.label).category != 'headset':
        return result
    if sk.ex.steps_left-sk.ex.reserve < 100 or sk.held.get(pp.arm) is None:
        return result
    samples=[];phase='stationary';old=sk.ex.on_step
    def read():
        w=sk.refresh();o=w.obj(pp.label);v=o.asset.mesh
        if v is None:return None
        V=np.asarray(v[0],float)
        if V.ndim!=2 or V.shape[1]!=3 or not len(V) or not np.isfinite(V).all():return None
        C=sk.kin.tcp(pp.arm,w.arms[pp.arm].q)
        return inv_T(C)@o.T,float((V@o.R.T+o.pos)[:,2].min()),float(o.pos[2])
    def stable(a,b):
        return np.linalg.norm(a[0][:3,3]-b[0][:3,3])<=.003 and angle_between_R(a[0][:3,:3],b[0][:3,:3])<=np.deg2rad(3)
    def capture(ex):
        if old is not None:old(ex)
        samples.append((phase,read()))
    initial=read()
    if initial is None or initial[1]<TABLE_Z+.003:return result
    try:
        sk.ex.on_step=capture;sk.ex.hold(30,name='headset_loaded_settle');reference=read()
        if reference is None or reference[1]<TABLE_Z+.003 or any(v is None or not stable(v,reference) for _,v in samples):return result
        h=sk.held[pp.arm];q=sk.world.arms[pp.arm].q;T=sk.kin.tcp(pp.arm,q);upT=T.copy();upT[2,3]+=.02
        up=sk.motion.line(pp.arm,q,upT,.02,'headset_load_up',gripper=CLOSED,held=h.box,ignore=(pp.label,),check=True)
        if not up.ok:return result
        down=sk.motion.line(pp.arm,up.q_end,T,.02,'headset_load_down',gripper=CLOSED,held=h.box,ignore=(pp.label,),check=True)
        if not down.ok:return result
        phase='challenge';p=ArmPlan(pp.arm,q,CLOSED).move(up,'up').hold(8,'loaded').move(down,'down').hold(8,'returned')
        sk.ex.run({pp.arm:p},name='headset_loaded_proof')
        challenged=[v for ph,v in samples if ph=='challenge']
        if not challenged or any(v is None or not stable(v,reference) for v in challenged):return result
        if max(v[1] for v in challenged)<TABLE_Z+.02 or max(v[2] for v in challenged)-reference[2]<.017:return result
        # Re-run the original hard slip/lift check against its original pre-pick root.
        # Derive that root from the original executed pick's expected/measured lift only in the wrapper below.
        final=sk.verify_pick(pp,sk._loaded_before)
        if not final.ok:return final
        return SkillResult(True,'pick','ok',result.steps+30+p.steps,pp.arm,final.expected,final.measured,
                           result.note+'; loaded proof passed (30 still, checked 20 mm up/return, <=3 mm/3 deg); final '+final.note)
    except (BudgetExceeded,EpisodeEnded) as exc:
        return SkillResult(False,'pick','step_budget' if isinstance(exc,BudgetExceeded) else 'ended',0,pp.arm,note=str(exc))
    finally:
        sk.ex.on_step=old
